string.name: text
string.value: You were assigned to speak to Evan, so you traveled to a farm in Henesys. As Evan's brother greeted you, another boy came whooshing in on a dragon.

string.name: text
string.value: Although Evan didn't know much about Seal Stones himself, he gathered some information from Afrien, a dragon friend of his.

string.name: text
string.value: Though you had to run a small errand in exchange for the information...

string.name: text
string.value: You and Evan commented on how young the other was, and then you returned to Maple Island.

string.name: text
string.value: When the others reconvened, you put together this knowledge:
